justification: Both show large, strictly profile human figures with elaborately patterned headgear, curled beard/hair conventions, bracelets at the wrist and outstretched hands, set in a horizontal relief register above or beside hoofed animals rendered in profile with patterned coats — a very specific set of shared depiction conventions. The main difference is the scene: A shows a single winged figure attending a stylised rosette-bearing plant and grasping a crouching creature, while B shows a procession of several wingless attendants leading curly-horned rams, so the narrative content and figure-to-figure relations differ.
